title: Public apply and staff recruitment review
summary: Signed-in public users can apply to open APES CIC roles and manage their own applications, and staff can review applications from the recruitment hub.
changes: Add apply on the public role detail page (one application per person per role) with a required interest statement.
Add My applications list and detail so signed-in public users can view status and withdraw when the workflow allows.
Add staff applications list with status, category, and role filters, plus review transitions and staff-only notes.
Prompt guests on open role detail to sign in or register before applying; deny access to other people’s applications and to staff review for public users.
Cover public apply, own-manage, staff review, and denial paths with PHPUnit feature tests.
version_rationale: Patch release on the v0.34.x line: completes the public apply and staff review UI on the application model from 0.34.3 without changing the roles board browse behaviour.
validation: PHPUnit RecruitmentApplicationManageTest, RecruitmentApplicationWorkflowTest, RecruitmentRoleWorkflowTest, PublicRecruitmentBoardTest, and ModuleStateMiddlewareTest pass.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Recruitment remains APES CIC only (not Shelter or Pet Care Clinic).
Each person may apply once per role; withdrawn applications cannot be resubmitted for the same role.
CV or document upload is not included in this release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove public apply, My applications, and staff application review routes and views from the live app.
provenance: Public apply and manage (#222), staff review (#223), and PHPUnit manage matrix (#224); pull request #245.
